setup.noise_model: independent Gaussian 3D neck-coordinate error; optimistic neck-position oracle
setup.bounds_m: center within 0.5 m of synthetic truth; unknown radius constrained to [0.05,0.30] m
setup.motion: one axis x; two axes x and z; independent x=sin(t) and z=sin(2t); maximum rotation-vector component indicated
setup.caveat: Direct 3D neck coordinates and known radius in the known case are oracle observations, not supplied by an image-only device; shape, soft tissue and correspondence errors omitted.
